description: This file defines REST API endpoints related to user information in the Superset application, including current user data retrieval, updating user info, and fetching user avatars.

classes.name: CurrentUserRestApi
classes.description: API for retrieving and updating the current user's information.

classes.name: UserRestApi
classes.description: API for retrieving user details and avatar images by user ID.

methods.name: pre_update
methods.description: Prepares user data before updating, including setting timestamps and hashing passwords.

methods.name: get_me
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's information.

methods.name: get_my_roles
methods.description: Returns roles associated with the current user.

methods.name: update_me
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile information.

methods.name: avatar
methods.description: Retrieves and redirects to the avatar URL for a specified user.
